about: Controlled vocabulary for Reference cards, loaded into the research store as approved on every open (new values only). Proposed values come from cards and are approved or rejected through the CLI. Sources: docs/research/skills-review.md.

values.label: Visual payoff
values.note: The first frame shows the reward the video promises

values.label: POV
values.note: Puts the viewer inside a situation: POV: you ...

values.label: List
values.note: Opens a count: N things, N places

values.label: Contrast
values.note: Expectation against reality, before against after

values.label: Question
values.note: Opens with a question the video answers

values.label: Curiosity gap
values.note: Withholds the key fact until later

values.label: Transformation
values.note: Turn X into Y

values.label: Diagnosis
values.note: The reason X fails is Y

values.label: Named framework
values.note: A sharp promise first, then the name of the method

values.label: Numbered series
values.note: Episode N of X, with a tension line after the label

values.label: Reaction promise
values.note: Promises a reaction the viewer cannot skip

values.label: Fake label
values.note: Trap: a name with nothing behind it

values.label: Bare number
values.note: Trap: a number with no mechanism in the same sentence

values.label: POV
values.note: The viewer walks through it in first person

values.label: Listicle
values.note: N things, counted through

values.label: Levels
values.note: Level 1 to level N, each one better than the last

values.label: Day In The Life
values.note: A day, start to finish

values.label: Reveal
values.note: Builds toward one thing shown last

values.label: Contrast
values.note: Two states set against each other

values.label: Breakdowns / Explainers
values.note: Takes one thing apart step by step

values.label: Case Studies

values.label: Tutorial
values.note: Does the thing on screen, step by step

values.label: Ranking/Rating/Tier List

values.label: A vs B Comparison
values.note: Two options set against each other

values.label: Reaction
values.note: Watching something and responding to it

values.label: Problem Solution

values.label: Q&A

values.label: About Me

values.label: Scenarios
values.note: Imagine this situation

values.label: Personal Update
